events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We reviewed your dispute about the $6.61 cancellation fee on this RydeX trip. The fee stands and no refund is due. Rides are matched with a driver at 9:30pm and you cancelled 3 minutes 20 seconds later, which is past the 3-minute grace period, so the fee applies. The $6.61 was charged exactly as published, so it isn't an excess charge. If your reason was a driver delay, that's handled through the RydeHELP appeal process, not by waiving this fee. No action has been taken on your account.

DRIVER: This dispute concerns a ride the rider cancelled, so there's no action on your side. The booking was matched with you and the rider cancelled 3 minutes 20 seconds later, past the 3-minute grace period, so the $6.61 cancellation fee is upheld and paid to you. You'll receive it as a Ryde voucher; no refund is due to the rider. Nothing is being recorded against your account and no review of your account is needed. No further action is required from you.
